# polaris-email

> A managed email service for the `polaris-*` family of internal apps. Cloudflare Workers control plane (REST, webhook fan-out, cron) plus an on-prem Go mail-bridge serving SMTPS (:465) and IMAP4rev2 (:993). One HMAC-signed REST contract covers outbound submission and inbound retrieval; v2-envelope signed webhooks deliver inbound events. Mailbox-centric schema, zero-payload-by-default, audit anchors anchored off Cloudflare on Backblaze B2 with Object Lock COMPLIANCE.

The site is organised by audience. Start at the section that matches your role; cross-links surface the spec pages when you need them.

## Get started

The first-deploy and first-send entry points.

- [What is polaris-email?](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/) — one-page overview, moving parts, audience picker.
- [Get started overview](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/get-started/overview) — two entry doors (operator vs developer) plus where to read next.
- [30-minute first deploy](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/get-started/30-min-first-deploy) — the operator-side hero tutorial. Cold Cloudflare account to first authenticated send.

## For developers

SDKs, signing, webhooks, the unified Message model, error catalogue.

- [Developer documentation overview](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/developers/overview) — entry index for the developer audience.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/developers/quickstart) — TypeScript, Go, and curl recipes for `POST /v1/messages` plus the webhook verifier.
- [HMAC concept](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/developers/authentication/concept) — narrative: what gets signed, the four headers, the skew window, why the idempotency key is separate from the nonce.
- [Node SDK](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/developers/sdks/node) — `@polaris/sdk` (signer, async-iterable pagination, typed errors, webhook verifier, React hooks).
- [Go SDK](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/developers/sdks/go) — `polaris-sdk-go` (typed `*APIError`, `WebhookEnvelope`, `VerifyAndParseWebhook`).
- [REST + curl](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/developers/sdks/rest-curl) — wire-level fallback for any other language.
- [Unified Message model](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/developers/messages/unified-model) — the single `Message` shape that backs inbound and outbound mail.
- [Webhook decision tree](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/developers/webhooks/decision-tree) — pick external HTTPS, tailnet, or bridge-proxied delivery.
- [Subscription lifecycle](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/developers/webhooks/lifecycle) — create, scope, verify, retry, dedupe, rotate, disable.
- [SMTP cookbook](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/developers/smtp-cookbook) — Nodemailer, PHPMailer, Go `net/smtp`, JavaMail, sendmail / msmtp.

## For operators

Cold-start, day-2 ops, incident response.

- [Operator documentation overview](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/overview) — entry index for the operator audience.
- [Architecture](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/concepts/architecture) — three Workers, one D1, mailbox-centric schema, off-Cloudflare audit anchors.
- [Cost model](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/concepts/cost-model) — forward bill projections at small/medium/large traffic.
- [Mail bridge](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/concepts/mail-bridge) — the on-prem Go binary, two equally-supported deployment modes.
- [Deployment prerequisites](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/deployment/prerequisites) — Cloudflare scopes, Backblaze B2 bucket, local tools.
- [Cold-start bootstrap](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/deployment/cold-start-bootstrap) — one-time setup that creates CF resources, seeds secrets, deploys, and mints the admin key.
- [Cloudflare Access setup](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/deployment/cloudflare-access) — OIDC IdP wiring, Terraform `access-app` module, group-based role sync.
- [Custom domains](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/deployment/custom-domains) — R2 public domain, panel, API, docs, per-tenant MTA-STS hostnames.
- [CLI tour](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/day-2/cli-tour) — `domain`, `cred`, `route`, `webhook`, `bridge`, `audit`, `suppression`, `status`, `auth`.
- [Domain management](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/day-2/domain-management) — CF zone discover/configure, declarative onboard, DKIM rotation, MTA-STS publishing.
- [Mailbox management](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/day-2/mailbox-management) — the unit everything else hangs off of.
- [Credential management](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/day-2/credential-management) — issue, list, rotate, revoke; read-once secrets policy.
- [Routing and webhooks](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/day-2/routing-and-webhooks) — inbound rules + webhook DLQ ops.
- [Bridge management](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/day-2/bridge-management) — register, rotate, deregister; per-bridge HMAC isolation.
- [Bridge TLS](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/day-2/bridge-tls) — mounted PEM, Lego ACME-DNS-01, Tailscale-issued.
- [Monitoring](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/day-2/monitoring) — Workers Analytics Engine, Logpush, `ALERT_WEBHOOK`, SLOs.
- [Activity inspection](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/day-2/activity-inspection) — red/yellow/green snapshot, queue depths, log tails, audit verify, suppression list.
- [On-call runbook](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/runbooks) — first commands and decision trees for common incidents.
- [Troubleshooting decision matrix](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/troubleshooting/decision-matrix) — symptom → cause → fix index.
- [Anchor maintenance](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/runbooks/anchor-maintenance) — detection and recovery for the hourly anchor cron.
- [Bridge credential sync](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/runbooks/bridge-credential-sync) — confirm drift, force resync, recover from HMAC key drift.
- [CF account compromise](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/runbooks/cf-account-compromise) — 15-minute containment, investigation, recovery.
- [Control-plane rotation](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/runbooks/control-plane-rotation) — `POLARIS_SECRET_A` A/B rotation dance.
- [D1 recovery](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/runbooks/d1-recovery) — PITR restore drill (quarterly).
- [Disaster recovery](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/runbooks/disaster-recovery) — escape hatches: lost state, lost admin key, bad deploy, leaked secret, bad phase marker.
- [Webhook DLQ](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/runbooks/webhook-dlq) — inspect, replay, drop, subscriber-outage cascade.
- [Retention and cleanup](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/runbooks/retention-and-cleanup) — what each retention class needs.
- [Data residency](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/operators/runbooks/data-residency) — where each class of stored data lives.

## For security reviewers

Threat model, HMAC spec, email authentication.

- [Security documentation overview](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/security/overview) — entry index for the security audience.
- [Threat model](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/security/threat-model) — trust boundaries, in-scope adversaries, mitigations, R2 capability semantics, audit-anchor integrity fence.
- [HMAC reference](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/security/hmac-reference) — byte-exact canonical-string, bare-hex header, domain tags, test vectors, verifier error codes.
- [DKIM / DMARC / SPF](https://docs.mail.plrs.im/security/dkim-dmarc-spf) — what polaris-email publishes per outbound domain, alignment rules, triage table, MTA-STS / TLS-RPT for inbound TLS.
